name: dev-flow
description: Drive one large, multi-phase or multi-PR change end to end — plan, execute task-by-task with a live ledger, ship per PR, and resume cleanly across sessions. Works in any repo that has a .claude/dev-flow-context.md.
author: PramodTKodag

name: dependency-audit
description: Audit dependencies for known vulnerabilities and outdated packages across npm/pnpm/yarn, Go, Python, and Cargo; produces a prioritized, read-only remediation report.
author: PramodTKodag

name: plan-flow
description: Investigate a GitHub issue against the real code — cross-service, security, design challenge — and write a self-contained implementation prompt for a separate coding session in any AI tool. Never implements the issue.
author: PramodTKodag
